desc.zh: 先看出每个玩家只有安装行和次日行有用，再用 MIN 压成每人一行、LEFT JOIN 查次日而不丢人。
desc.en: See that only each player's install row and next-day row matter, shrink to one row per player with MIN, then LEFT JOIN the next day without losing anyone.

complexity: O(n log n) time with the primary-key index (n Activity rows); O(p) intermediate space for p players

concepts.name: One row per player
concepts.description: Only the install row and the next-day row matter, so GROUP BY player_id with MIN(event_date) first.

concepts.name: LEFT JOIN keeps the denominator
concepts.description: Unmatched installers stay as NULL rows, so COUNT(*) counts installs and COUNT(column) counts returns.
